required.label: Trip ID & In-App Receipt Screenshot
required.reason: Shows the official Trip ID, upfront fare breakdown, and distance/duration recorded by the app.

required.label: M-Pesa Statement / Cash Payment Confirmation
required.source: TAWU Financial Dispute Checklist & Platform Earnings Policy
required.reason: An M-Pesa Statement provides verifiable proof of the exact digital payment received or non-payment for contested trip fares.

optional.label: GPS Route & Google Maps Timeline Log
optional.source: TAWU Appeal Best Practice & Platform Distance Dispute Terms
optional.reason: Confirms the actual route driven and traffic delays when the final fare differs from the upfront estimate.

optional.label: In-App Chat / Customer Call Screenshot
optional.reason: Documents any in-app messages where the passenger agreed to a route change, stop, or cash/M-Pesa payment.

required.label: Deactivation Notice / App Fraud Warning Screen
required.source: NTSA LN 120 Reg 15(1) & Uber/Bolt/Little Fraud Policies
required.reason: Establishes the exact algorithmic allegation and date of suspension required for formal due-process review under NTSA Reg 15(1).

required.label: Chronological Trip Log & Explanation
required.source: TAWU Legal Guidance on Algorithmic Locks
required.reason: Provides a trip-by-trip timeline accounting for flagged journeys, network drops, or legitimate repeat pickups.

optional.label: Google Maps Location History Export
optional.reason: Verifies actual vehicle trajectory and drop-off coordinates against automated GPS-spoofing or fake-trip flags.

optional.label: Passenger M-Pesa Receipt for Cash Trip
optional.source: Little Cab / Faras Financial Audit Terms
optional.reason: Proves that a real paying passenger completed the trip and paid via M-Pesa, refuting collusive or ghost-trip claims.

required.label: Incident Details & Exact Timestamp Log
required.reason: Incident Details and exact timestamps allow platform safety teams to match your report against trip telemetry under NTSA Reg 18(2).

required.label: Official Police Abstract (if crash, injury, or assault occurred)
required.source: NTSA LN 120 Reg 11(b) & TAWU Safety Protocol
required.reason: Mandatory legal documentation for reporting physical threats, accidents, or criminal behavior under NTSA rules.

optional.label: Dashcam Footage (Audio/Video Log)
optional.source: NTSA LN 120 Reg 18(1) & Platform Safety Guidelines
optional.reason: Serves as objective visual and audio evidence to clear false passenger or safety allegations.

optional.label: Third-Party / Security Guard / Witness Statement
optional.reason: Corroborates your account using an independent observer such as a stage marshal, estate guard, or bystander.

required.label: In-App Conversation / Call Activity Screenshot
required.reason: Shows polite communication, pickup pin mismatches, or rider requests to cancel before the dispute occurred.

required.label: Written Driver Counter-Statement
required.source: NTSA LN 120 Reg 15 Due Process Mandate
required.reason: Exercises your statutory right to be heard under NTSA Reg 15(1) by recording your factual version of the interaction.

optional.label: Dashcam Clip showing interaction
optional.reason: Serves as objective visual and audio evidence to clear false passenger or safety allegations.

optional.label: Historical Driver Star Rating & Compliment History
optional.source: Uber / Bolt / Yego Quality Review Terms
optional.reason: Demonstrates a consistent track record of safe, professional service prior to an isolated retaliatory rating.

required.label: Valid Kenyan National ID & Driver License
required.reason: Confirms driver identity and valid Kenyan driving class authorization under NTSA Reg 21(a).

required.label: Valid PSV Badge & Police Clearance Certificate (Good Conduct)
required.source: NTSA LN 120 Reg 21(b) & Little/Faras Onboarding Standards
required.reason: Proves active statutory PSV licensing and valid DCI Certificate of Good Conduct required under NTSA Reg 21(b).

required.label: Valid Vehicle Inspection Certificate & PSV Insurance Cover
required.reason: Verifies current NTSA annual vehicle roadworthiness inspection and valid commercial PSV insurance.

optional.label: Real-Time Clear Selfie Photo
optional.source: Uber Real-Time ID / Bolt Selfie Verification Standard
optional.reason: Resolves automated facial-recognition or liveness-check lockouts caused by poor lighting or camera glare.

optional.label: Vehicle Photos (Front, Back, Dashboard, Interior)
optional.source: NTSA Reg 15 Maintenance & Platform Onboarding Checklist
optional.reason: Confirms registration plate visibility and clean vehicle condition following a vehicle-quality hold.
